text:
maria: Quick sync. We need to finalize run-of-show and speaker talking points. 30-45m? Ada?

ada: 45m gives breathing room. Go with 45.

sam: Agree. More time for Qs -> better engagement scoring.

kevin: design note: 16:9 slides, use our brand light theme, and include 'setup' slide for demo.

prashant: will keep tech section to 15m: 3 levers: batching, routing, caching. plan for 6 slides + one code snippet slide.

nora: I'll anonymize customer metrics and prepare a 'what changed' slide with before/after charts.

maria: proposed run-of-show (45m):
- 0:00-0:03 host intro, goals, housekeeping
- 0:03-0:18 product ops (prashant)
- 0:18-0:28 customer case study (nora)
- 0:28-0:35 pre-recorded demo clip (60s) + quick live check
- 0:35-0:43 live Q&A (moderated)
- 0:43-0:45 CTAs + resources + evaluation kit link

sam: also suggest 2 quick polls during the session to keep attention (poll after intro + poll before Qs).

ops-bot: Poll integration ready.

ada: speaker prep: each speaker to send 3 bullets of talking points + 1 backup anecdote. upload to shared doc.

prashant: talking points: 1) batching basics + cost math 2) KV/prefix caching benefits 3) model routing + fallback policy example. backup anecdote: when fallback saved a customer during model OOM.

nora: talking points: 1) before/after metrics 2) org impact (dev time saved) 3) tips for measurement. backup: how we rolled changes with feature flags.

kevin: will prepare speaker slide template + lower thirds. need headshots 200x200 by Tue.

maria: promotions checklist: email, blog, social posts, paid creative. Sam to own HubSpot journey.

sam: confirmed. Also will add hidden field source=webinar_serving_ops and tags for the SDR queue mapping.

maria: rehearsal schedule: tech check Thu 09:50 PT, dry run Fri 10:00 PT, dress run Mon 09:00 PT. please mark calendar.

kevin: uploaded slide template -> https://drive.company/templates/webinar_template_v2.pptx

maria: final ask: can someone write 2 short subject lines optimized for opens? keep one 'cost' angle, one 'SLA' angle.

elena (Content): draft subject lines: "Cut inference costs — real levers teams use" and "Hit latency SLAs without breaking the bank". will A/B test.

ops-bot: Reminder: recording retention set to 90 days.

maria: great, sticking to timeline. post assets here when ready. closing.
